question: What form does one make when the mind becomes one-pointed in meditation?
premises: kurute bahudhā rūpaṃ means makes form in many ways
dhyāna eka gata cetasaḥ means mind gone one-pointed in meditation
inference: The verse states that one-pointed meditation mind makes form in many ways.
uncertainties: whether bahudhā modifies kurute or rūpaṃ
plain_english: One makes form in many ways when the mind becomes one-pointed in meditation.
